content.comment_body: [product_name] [product_name] powers up significantly faster than [product_name], which results in messages appearing on the display while the [product_name] is still initializing. This means [product_name] cannot send out those messages until its startup process is complete. Is there a way to send an SMS request from a mobile phone to the [product_name] to receive all currently active messages that are shown on the [product_name] display again? The messages are all indicated by a digital flag.
You can configure a power-on trigger and set a delay time in the [product_name] to keep it waiting until the [product_name] is ready.
Within the setup menu of the [product_name], you can adjust the delay time for start-up in 0.2 second increments.

analysis.insight_summary: Users identified a synchronization challenge between [product_name] modules during system power-up. The main module initializes faster and shows status messages before the communication module is ready to send alerts, resulting in missed SMS notifications. There is no direct function to request these initial messages via SMS from the communication module.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to remotely request all currently active messages via SMS from the communication module to ensure no important messages are lost during initial startup.
